title: Update oxfmt to version 0.70.0
body:
Follow-up on: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/40668

Background: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/37774#issuecomment-5700908489

Part of series of misc JS/lint/format/etc cleanup type stuff in advance of eslint/oxlint switch.

First commit runs update, second commit applies (smallish?) collection of reformats from the tool.

Side note - I see a pretty substantial speedup locally from this change ... from ~400ms on current main to ~200ms on this branch when just running `oxfmt`. Granted this is pretty fast to begin with but given its in the lint staged config, that might be noticeable.
